meals.title: Braai Boerewors Rolls with Coal-Roasted Butternut
meals.why: Boerewors is R99.99/kg at Checkers (R89.99 with a loyalty card) and butternut is only R14.99/kg, so a whole braai dinner costs very little.
method: Slice the butternut into thick wedges, toss with oil, salt and pepper, and wrap in foil.
Put the foil parcels on the edge of the coals for about 30 minutes, turning once, until soft.
Braai the boerewors over medium coals for 15-20 minutes, turning occasionally.
Fry sliced onions with a splash of tomato sauce for a quick smoor.
Serve the wors in the hotdog rolls with the onion smoor and butternut on the side.

meals.title: Shakshuka with Toast
meals.why: Tinned tomatoes (R14.99), a 6-pack of eggs and a sachet of paprika make a filling vegetarian dinner for under R70.
method: Soften a chopped onion and garlic in oil in a wide pan.
Stir in 1 tsp paprika and the tomato paste, then add the chopped tomatoes.
Simmer for 10 minutes until thick, then season with salt and pepper.
Make 4-6 wells in the sauce, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5-7 minutes until the whites are set.
Serve straight from the pan with toasted bread.

meals.title: Tuna Mayo Rice Bowls with Cucumber
meals.why: Shredded tuna at R21.99 a tin, parboiled rice and a big tub of Nola mayo make a cheap, no-fuss meal that needs very little cooking.

uses.item: No Name Live Well Shredded Tuna in Salt Water 170g

method: Cook the rice according to the packet, about 18-20 minutes.
Drain the tuna and mix with 2-3 tbsp mayo and a squeeze of lemon.
Slice the cucumber and grate the carrots, then dress them with a little vinegar and salt.
Spoon the rice into bowls and top with the tuna mix, cucumber and carrot.
Finish with a drizzle of soy sauce and sesame seeds if you have them.

meals.title: Oven-Baked Paprika Chicken with Butternut and Carrots
meals.why: A 2kg braai pack of chicken is R94.99, and with R14.99/kg butternut and carrots everything cooks together in one tray.

uses.item: No Name Frozen Chicken Braai Pack 2kg

method: Thaw the chicken fully and heat the oven to 200°C.
Rub the chicken with oil, 2 tbsp paprika, garlic, herbs, salt and pepper.
Chop the butternut and carrots into chunks and spread them in a large roasting tray.
Place the chicken on top and roast for 60-70 minutes, turning the veg once, until the chicken is cooked through and golden.
Rest for 5 minutes and spoon the pan juices over the veg.

meals.title: Cottage Pie with Butternut-Carrot Mash
meals.why: Checkers lean beef mince is R109.99/kg (R99.99 with a loyalty card), and a butternut and carrot mash stretches it for a family at R14.99/kg per veg.
method: Boil peeled, cubed butternut and half the carrots until soft, then drain and mash with a knob of Stork spread and salt.
Brown the mince with chopped onion and garlic, and grate in the remaining carrots.
Add the chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, crumbled stock cube and herbs, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Tip the mince into an ovenproof dish and spread the mash over the top.
Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes until golden on top.

meals.title: Spicy Chicken Livers in Tomato Sauce with Rice
meals.why: A 500g pack of chicken livers is just R24.99, which makes this one of the cheapest protein dinners on special.
method: Thaw the livers, pat them dry and trim off any sinew.
Start the rice cooking according to the packet.
Fry the onion and garlic in oil, then add the livers and fry for 4-5 minutes until browned.
Stir in the paprika, tomato paste, chopped tomatoes and chilli, then simmer for 8-10 minutes until the sauce is thick and the livers are cooked through.
Serve over the rice.
